definition-dropped.answer: 2002 'type (for type declaration): A template that contains all the characteristics of a data item and its subordinates' (§2002:4); 8.5.3 decides 'same type', and within one source element that is the same TYPE clause or the same subordinate item of one declaration (§2002:8.5.3 NOTE). 2023's additions (STRONG/EXTERNAL presence, aligned, dynamic length, bit) concern constructs 2002 lacks or that SR3's both-strongly-typed premise already fixes; the different-type refusal (w-pb348-read-into-strong-group.cob, COBOL1533 at 2002) shows it.

pending-clause.answer: 8.5.3 (near) supplies SR3's 'same type' and is answered above: unchanged for 2002 programs. 8.5.4 (zero-length items) and 14.5.8 (alignment, removed) were flagged by the word 'type' alone; SR3 says nothing about zero-length items or alignment, so neither bears on it.

behaviour-switch.answer: The switch (DialectBehavior.IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd) changes only a sequential READ PREVIOUS that is the first retrieval after OPEN on an indexed file, the case of §2002:14.8.29.3 GR18c; this rule does not govern that case, and its own behaviour at --std 2002 is shown by the compile-time probes the read names (COBOL1995, COBOL1533 at 2002); a syntax rule the run-time switch cannot reach. Separately, the switch's own 2002 arm is wrong (a defect lead, not this row's): probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/op-20261114/read-2002/out-answer/probes-a-05/read-prev-open-2002.cob gives P1=K002|00 at --std 2002 (and 2014), where §2002:14.8.26.3 GR12 sets an indexed file's position indicator to the lowest-ordinal characters and §2002:14.8.29.3 GR18c selects a record whose key is 'less than or equal to the file position indicator', none, so GR18 gives status 10 and the at end condition (2023 prints ATEND|10); code site IndexedConnector.SelectSequentialRecord (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/IO/IndexedConnector.cs:445) with DialectBehavior.IndexedReadPreviousAfterOpenAtEnd (DialectBehavior.cs:297, kb/Work PB344).
